He does not believe it will keep him out long term: 'Knowing me, I am going to be ready to go next week because I've sat out enough in my career.' Imaging to be done Monday. Coach Kevin Stefanski previously confirmed imaging pending. No diagnosis or official Week 6 designation yet. Final line 19/32, 240 yds, 1 TD.
